skill.summary: Analyze stocks and cryptocurrencies using Yahoo Finance data. Supports portfolio management, watchlists with alerts, dividend analysis, 8-dimension stock scoring, viral trend detection (Hot Scanner), and rumor/early signal detection. Use for stock analysis, portfolio tracking, earnings reactions, crypto monitoring, trending stocks, or finding rumors before they hit mainstream.
